# Central versions of every Python package the samples use, with the SHA-256
# of each file PyPI publishes for that version. A sample's requirements.txt
# activates this file with -c and lists bare package names; pip installs only
# files whose hash is listed here and rejects anything else. pip 26.3 or newer
# applies these hashes to the bare names.
#
# To change a version, edit its pin, then rewrite the hashes from the
# Application-Samples-Infra repository:
#   python scripts/update-python-hashes.py
